findings.evidence: Mathlib's entire Function.Even/Odd API is dot notation: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/EvenFunction.lean:57 Even.left_comp`, `:61 Even.comp_odd`, `:67 Odd.comp_odd`, `:124 Even.mul_odd`, `:164 Odd.map_zero`. grep for `Even\.deriv|Odd\.deriv` in Mathlib returns nothing, so the name is free.
findings.fix: Rename to `Function.Even.deriv` (namespace `Function.Even`, argument `hf` implicit-free as now), and update the two call sites to `ih.deriv` / `(reduced_neg l).deriv` in SphericalBessel/Basic.lean:113,114,125.
findings.issue: `EpsilonEridani.odd_deriv_of_even (hf : Function.Even f) : Function.Odd (deriv f)` has a first explicit argument of Mathlib type `Function.Even f`, so it belongs in that type's namespace.

findings.evidence: Mathlib files such lemmas under `Continuous` even when it is not the first argument: `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Separation/Hausdorff.lean:519 theorem Continuous.ext_on [T2Space X] {s : Set Y} (hs : Dense s) {f g : Y → X} (hf : Continuous f)` — the very lemma this proof applies.
findings.fix: Rename to `Continuous.eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero` so `hf.eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero h` elaborates, and reword the docstring to the hypothesis actually assumed (`x • f x = 0` for all `x`).
findings.issue: `EpsilonEridani.eq_zero_of_forall_smul_eq_zero (hf : Continuous f) (h : ∀ x, x • f x = 0) : f = 0` takes `Continuous f` as its first explicit argument but is not in the `Continuous` namespace. Its docstring ("A continuous function `f` that vanishes away from the origin is zero everywhere") also states a hypothesis the theorem does not take — the hypothesis is `∀ x, x • f x = 0`, and the name silently drops the continuity hypothesis without which the statement is false.

findings.evidence: grep for `_succ'` in code/EpsilonEridani returns only these two declarations and their three uses; no `hasDerivAt_sphericalBesselJ_succ` or `deriv_sphericalBesselJ_succ` exists. The PR description itself names them `hasDerivAt_sphericalBesselJ_succ` / `deriv_sphericalBesselJ_succ` without the prime.
findings.fix: Drop the primes: `hasDerivAt_sphericalBesselJ_succ`, `deriv_sphericalBesselJ_succ`, and update the uses at lines 294 and 339 plus the module docstring at line 46.
findings.issue: `hasDerivAt_sphericalBesselJ_succ'` and `deriv_sphericalBesselJ_succ'` (line 291) carry primes marking a variant of a lemma that does not exist; consumers will search for the unprimed names and find nothing.

summary: Two declarations whose first explicit argument is a Mathlib type are filed under the bare EpsilonEridani namespace instead of that type's namespace, blocking dot notation and upstreaming; and two theorems carry primes with no unprimed counterpart.
